newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse index drops in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse index drops in lacklustre trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index fell significantly on Monday, pulled down by losses in just two blue chips.
Traders said the tiny volume traded overall underlined deteriorating sentiment on the bourse.
The GSE All-Share Index slumpped by 1.71 points to 360.62.

The numbers of shares traded, falling steadily in recent sessions, sank to 11,140 compared with 34,710 changing hands at the last session on Friday. Offers far exceeded bids at 552,440 shares to 136,240.
The market was pulled down by Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH which lost 15 cedis to 630, and Kumasi Brewery Ltd, down five cedis to 705.
